column6: All the windstorms and gales arose together, and the flood swept over the ……. After the flood had swept over the land, and waves and windstorms had rocked the huge boat for seven days and seven nights, @wDN{Utu} the sun god came out, illuminating heaven and earth. @wRN{Zi-ud-sura} could drill an opening in the huge boat and the hero @wDN{Utu} entered the huge boat with his rays. @wRN{Zi-ud-sura} the king prostrated himself before @wDN{Utu}. The king sacrificed oxen and offered innumerable sheep.
